title: Planning for Secure Water Futures in Contexts of Drought and Displacement: Evidence from Mafraq, Jordan
organization: UN-Habitat Jordan and International Institute for Environment and Development
geographic_coverage: Dahiyyat Al-Malik Abdullah neighborhood, Mafraq City
temporal_coverage: Neighborhood fieldwork and water assessment reported in 2026; selected historical water, population and satellite indicators date to 2014–2025.
methodology: Mixed methods: desk review, GIS, 70-household survey, fieldwork and stakeholder workshops.
limitations: Mafraq case; local survey is not national; over-abstraction is also a water deficit driver.

title: Integrating Climate Security into Policies: Roadmap for Jordan
temporal_coverage: Qualitative risk pathways and institutional assessment, 2023; climate projections discussed in the report extend through 2100.
methodology: Year-long desk research, interviews, consultations and government validation.
limitations: Qualitative pathways synthesize secondary research; no causal impact evaluation.

title: Vulnerability Assessment of the Water Sector to Climate Change in Jordan
organization: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia
temporal_coverage: Reference climate period 1995–2014; near-term 2021–2040 and mid-term 2041–2060 projections.
methodology: RICCAR geospatial water-sector assessment combines exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indicators with six downscaled climate models.
limitations: National assessment; some indicators were omitted where comparable data were unavailable; projections are model outputs, not observations.

title: Jordan Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Country conditions and regional shocks through 2022; selected climate projections extend to 2040.
methodology: World Bank country climate and development analysis; relevant executive-summary passages inspected.
limitations: National-level findings; inspected executive-summary projection does not specify its climate scenario.

title: Completion of ICRC Water Program: Host Communities and Syrian Refugees in Jordan 2014–2023
organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
temporal_coverage: ICRC infrastructure program 2014–2022; evaluation findings through 2022 and capacity-building actions in 2023.
methodology: Report compiles works and external evaluation through 2022.
limitations: Efficiency later declined amid maintenance gaps.
